title: explainer-signature/v1
description: nodes/<id>/explainer/signed/<hash>-<n>.yaml (F15-R8; D-3 v3.17): a real-identity contributor's signature on one explainer, affirming one sentence — I can explain this proof without the tool that produced it. It claims nothing about the mathematics, changes no verdict and earns nothing at merge; only signed explainers count toward a resolved target's digestion state (D-33 v3.17). Signed with the signer's own SSH key (SSHSIG, opn_gate.signed) over the canonical body, the document without `signature`. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

explainer.description: The SHA-256 of the explainer file the signature is on — its name under explainer/ (D-3: content-hashed). A signature whose explainer is absent is refused by name.

affirmation.description: The fixed sentence, verbatim (opn_gate.explainers.AFFIRMATION). Any other text is refused.

signer.description: The signer's GitHub login. At Stage 0 a real-identity contributor is an active steward of the target or a listed curator (F15-Q4).
